title: Nested Sampling: A Critical and Comprehensive Theoretical Guide
abstract: arXiv:2606.17916v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The nested sampling (NS) technique has gained widespread attention, particularly in cosmology and astronomy, due to its ability to efficiently explore high-likelihood regions - a feature akin to an implicit likelihood optimization that underlies its success. While the full theoretical derivation of NS is complex and involves several approximations, the central challenge lies in sampling from the likelihood-constrained priors, which is crucial for its performance. This work provides a comprehensive and detailed exposition of NS derivation, clarifying both its theoretical foundations and practical challenges. We provide a thorough description of the NS procedure, emphasizing both its strengths and potential limitations. The connections between NS, importance sampling (IS), and vertical Monte Carlo are also discussed in detail. translated_title: 嵌套采样：批判性与全面的理论指南
translated_abstract: 嵌套采样（NS）技术因其在高效探索高似然区域方面的能力而受到广泛关注，尤其在宇宙学和天文学领域——这一特性类似于一种隐式的似然优化，是其成功的基石。尽管NS的完整理论推导较为复杂且涉及多个近似，但其核心挑战在于从受似然约束的先验中进行采样，这对NS的性能至关重要。本工作对NS的推导进行了全面而详细的阐述，澄清了其理论基础与实践挑战。我们对NS的流程进行了透彻的描述，着重强调其优势与潜在的局限性。文中还详细讨论了NS与重要性采样（IS）以及垂直蒙特卡洛之间的联系。通过上述工作，本文旨在加深对该方法的理解，并促进未来方法的发展。
tldr: 本文全面而批判性地阐述了嵌套采样的理论推导与实践挑战，指出其成功的关键在于从受似然约束的先验中高效采样，并系统梳理了它与重要性采样及垂直蒙特卡洛之间的联系。
en_tdlr: This work provides a comprehensive and critical theoretical exposition of nested sampling, highlighting that its success hinges on efficiently sampling from likelihood-constrained priors, and details its connections to importance sampling and vertical Monte Carlo.
